prompt: Vertical 9:16 smartphone video, photorealistic. Inside a bright, busy Japanese ramen shop. A cheerful young Japanese man in a plain gray t-shirt sits at a wooden counter in front of a GIGANTIC bowl of tonkotsu ramen as wide as a car tire, piled with a mountain of bean sprouts, thick slices of chashu pork, and soft-boiled eggs, steam rising. Audio: loud satisfying slurping and chewing sounds, staff shouting encouragement in Japanese, lively shop ambience. No on-screen text.
